evals.prompt: Initialize this folder as a new git repository using the trunk-first workflow. Use the default maturity level and branch context init.
evals.expected_output: The workflow collects the required parameters, creates an orphan main branch with a seed commit, and switches to a versioned feature branch.
expectations: Collects parameters using FORMS.md before running commands
Uses an orphan main branch and an empty seed commit
Creates and switches to a versioned feature branch such as v0.1.0/init

evals.prompt: Set up a new repository with trunk-based development and configure origin https://github.com/example/demo.git.
evals.expected_output: The workflow initializes trunk-first git history and adds the provided remote origin.
expectations: Adds the provided remote URL after initialization
Pushes or documents pushing main when a remote is provided

evals.prompt: I want a production-grade repo from day one with branch context release-prep.
evals.expected_output: The workflow chooses the production version prefix and creates the correct branch name without bypassing the PR-first model.
expectations: Uses v1.0.0 for the production-grade choice
Reinforces never committing directly to main after the seed commit
